Title: Release of Service Fabric SDK Preview 0.8.0.0 and Runtime Preview 5.5.0.2 for Linux

Body.Content:
The Azure Service Fabric SDK preview and runtime preview for Linux have received minor updates: version 0.8.0.0 and version 5.5.0.2, respectively. These updates contain several bug fixes and improvements.

This change is a breaking release because clusters with previous runtimes will not be upgraded to 5.5.0.2, and your Java code will need to be recompiled. For more details, see the release notes.
